Latest Update: GPU racks can now produce all seven base game science packs, unlocked through research.

Jensen World

This mod brings the GPU supply chain to Factorio, starting at rack scale and increasing in realism with each version.

Features

  • GPU Rack Manufacturing Technology (requires 300 x red, 300 x green and 300 x blue science packs)
  • GB300 NVL72 Rack with selectable science production using electricity and water
  • Research six GPU science upgrades after reaching the corresponding base game science milestones
  • Full rack assembly chain with 19 craftable components, from chips and memory modules through superchips, networking boards and SSDs to rack components

Chips
B300 GPU Grace CPU NVSwitch Chip (NVLink 5) ConnectX-8 Chip
2 per superchip 1 per superchip 2 per NVLink switch tray 2 per SuperNIC mezzanine board
Blackwell Ultra GPU for the GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip. CPU for the GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip. Routes NVLink traffic between GPUs. Networking ASIC for a SuperNIC mezzanine board.
BlueField-3 DPU Chip Spectrum-1 Ethernet Switch Chip LPDDR5X Memory Module
1 per DPU board 1 per SN2201 switch 4 per superchip
Data processing ASIC for a DPU board. Routes Ethernet traffic between network ports. Memory module for the Grace CPU.

Server Components
GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip ConnectX-8 SuperNIC Mezzanine Board BlueField-3 DPU Board E1.S NVMe Cache SSD M.2 NVMe Boot SSD
2 per compute tray 2 per compute tray 1 per compute tray 4 per compute tray 1 per compute tray
Combines two B300 GPUs, one Grace CPU and four LPDDR5X memory modules. Carries two ConnectX-8 chips for high speed networking between GPU racks. Provides storage networking, security and infrastructure management for the compute tray. Cache drive for the GB300 NVL compute tray. Boot drive for the GB300 NVL compute tray.

Trays
GB300 NVL Compute Tray NVLink Switch Tray NVIDIA SN2201 Switch Power Shelf
18 per rack 9 per rack 2 per rack 8 per rack
Houses the rack's computing hardware. Connects the GPUs through NVLink. Provides the rack's management-network connections. Converts incoming power for the rack's hardware.

Cabling, Cooling and Power
Cable Cartridge Backplane Liquid Cooling Manifold Power Bus Bar
4 per rack 2 per rack 1 per rack
Cartridge of copper cables connecting the rack's GPUs to its NVLink switches. Distributes coolant through the GB300 NVL72 rack. Distributes DC electricity through the rack.
